topic: remove rust stains from a bathroom or kitchen sink
core_question: How do I get rust stains out of a sink? (secondary: How do I get rid of dust spots showing up in my photos from the camera sensor?)
answer_summary: Make a paste of lemon juice with baking soda or cream of tartar, apply to the rust stain, scrub, and rinse.; after the topic shift: Use a rocket air blower on the sensor in the camera's manual sensor-cleaning mode; if spots persist, use a dedicated sensor cleaning swab with sensor cleaning solution, or have it professionally cleaned.
persona: friendly but persistent; texting quickly with typos here and there
